usedFor: Anchor Browser reports when a task or session ends, and Kit tags a subscriber through “Add Tag to Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a task fails” in Anchor Browser, then “Add Tag to Subscriber” in Kit
bestTemplate.why: A failed task is the event worth marking, and the action tags a specific Kit subscriber.

watchOut: Anchor Browser events describe tasks, not people, so decide how “Add Tag to Subscriber” finds the subscriber.
